metadata.system: Green Steel crafting — single-pick choice-slot over the endgame-relevant effect pool
metadata.status: SHELVED — no Legendary hosts in the catalog. Machinery complete; pool intentionally empty.
metadata.harvest_finding: Confirmed at the wiki + catalog (2026-07-28, KTD4/KTD5): Legendary Green Steel (LGS, Update 29, ~ML29) DOES exist on the wiki as 'Legendary Green Steel items' (an augment-crafting system — Tier 1/2/3 recipes make augments that slot into a chosen blank). BUT the gear-planner catalog carries no LGS blanks: its 97 Green Steel shells are the classic Heroic/Epic ones, ML11-26 (0 at ML>=29), so U3's Legendary-only host filter marks zero hosts. The catalog holds 2,350 ML>=29 items overall, so endgame gear isn't missing generally — LGS blanks specifically aren't in the gear-planner source. Feature parked under the endgame-BiS scope: no Legendary hosts to attach to. Sourcing LGS properly would require harvesting the ML29 LGS blank items into the catalog as a NEW host shard and modeling augment-crafting — a substantial effort for gear at the very bottom (ML29) of the ML30-36 band.
